g.text: U1: +3V3D (MCU) and, via FB1, +3V3_CLK (Si5351 + TCXO). Rev F U1/C1/C2/C3.

g.desc: U1: +3V3D (MCU) and, via FB1, +3V3_CLK (Si5351 + TCXO). Rev F U1/C1/C2/C3.

g.text: - J1: UART adapter schematic pairs GCT USB4105 footprint with this HCTL LCSC part; HCTL footprint used here - confirm. Shield to GND assumed (not stated in PLAN).

g.desc: - J1: UART adapter schematic pairs GCT USB4105 footprint with this HCTL LCSC part; HCTL footprint used here - confirm. Shield to GND assumed (not stated in PLAN).

g.text: - D1: Pin-to-line mapping (D-/D+/VBUS on pins 2/3/4) to be checked against adapter layout.

g.desc: - D1: Pin-to-line mapping (D-/D+/VBUS on pins 2/3/4) to be checked against adapter layout.

g.text: - C10: LCSC stock low; fallback C49678 (0805) per PLAN

g.desc: - C10: LCSC stock low; fallback C49678 (0805) per PLAN

g.text: - U3: Unused CP2102N pins left NC (adapter used DTR via JP1, TRRS dropped). Confirm none were strapped on the adapter.

g.desc: - U3: Unused CP2102N pins left NC (adapter used DTR via JP1, TRRS dropped). Confirm none were strapped on the adapter.

g.text: - R9: PLAN says /RST pull-up to VBUS (as on adapter); CP2102N RST max is VIO-referenced - confirm adapter really ties to VBUS.

g.desc: - R9: PLAN says /RST pull-up to VBUS (as on adapter); CP2102N RST max is VIO-referenced - confirm adapter really ties to VBUS.

g.text: USB-C input, CP2102N USB-UART (from EtherkitUARTAdapter), LP2985 rails (U1 from Rev F; U5 dedicated to OLED per Jason 2026-10-22)

g.desc: USB-C input, CP2102N USB-UART (from EtherkitUARTAdapter), LP2985 rails (U1 from Rev F; U5 dedicated to OLED per Jason 2026-10-22)

g.text: U5: OLED-only rail (Eyes On The Prize lesson, PLAN 4a). Place U5/FB2/C22-C24 at the OLED header.
